claims: Carabao is Bubalus bubalis carabanesis.
Carabaos are domesticated swamp-type water buffaloes.
Carabaos are found in the Philippines and Guam.
Carabaos are used as draft animals for farming.
Carabaos have low, wide, and heavy builds.
Carabaos have light grey to slate grey skin.
Carabaos have sickle-shaped horns.
Carabaos sometimes have a thin layer of hair.
Mature male carabaos weigh 420–500 kg (930–1,100 lb).
Female carabaos weigh 400–425 kg (880–940 lbs).
Carabaos are primarily used to plow rice paddies.
Carabaos are often treated as family pets.
Carabaos were introduced to Guam for farming.
Carabaos were essential for transportation in Guam during the 1700s and 1800s.
The name carabao is derived from the Visayan karabáw via Philippine Spanish.
The name carabao first appeared in English around 1900.
Carabao Energy Drink is a Thai energy drink brand.
Carabao Cup is the commercial name for the English Football League Cup.
Carabao is a Thai rock band.
Carabao Restaurant is a Filipiniana dining spot in Napa Valley.
